questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}x_{t}^{\prime}&=\frac{1}{1+t^{2}},\ y_{t}^{\prime}=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}},\ z_{t}^{\prime}=\frac{5t}{2(1+t^{2})^{2}}, \text{由于与三个坐标轴的夹角相等，则夹角的余弦也相等：}\\&\cos \alpha=\frac{x_{t}^{\prime}}{\sqrt{x_{t}^{\prime 2}+y_{t}^{\prime 2}+z_{t}^{\prime 2}}}, \cos \beta=\frac{y_{t}^{\prime}}{\sqrt{x_{t}^{\prime 2}+y_{t}^{\prime 2}+z_{t}^{\prime 2}}}, \cos \gamma=\frac{z_{t}^{\prime}}{\sqrt{x_{t}^{\prime 2}+y_{t}^{\prime 2}+z_{t}^{\prime 2}}},\\ \text{得到：}\ \frac{1}{1+t^{2}}&=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}=\frac{5t}{2(1+t^{2})^{2}}, \text{解得}t=\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
